cues.notes: D2 electric hum, 4 s seamless; content < 3 kHz so AudioSource.pitch 0.5..2 stays clean.
Granular regolith crunch under wheels, 4 s seamless; volume follows speed x grounded.
Soft rubbery stick-slip creak + quiet spring tone; no resonance above ~1.2 kHz (never squeaky).
Soft whump (98->47 Hz glide) + body + slow dust hiss; runtime scales by impact.
Warm AM/vinyl static, 6 s seamless stereo; volume rises as radio clarity falls.
Dial-tuning swish (static swell + sweeping resonant band) under the crossfade between tracks.
72 s seamless stereo lunar hush with 10 sparse distant pentatonic tones in a long reverb.
Kalimba D5 (tine partial 6.27x, felt-pick transient).
One variant per relic (label = relic id) on its answer note from Data/Content/Relics: shimmering soft bell + octave, tremolo 6.5 Hz.
Servo whir D3/A3 + air while 07 is lifted to safety; content < 3.2 kHz for the pitch glide.
Air release + A3 -> D3 servo settle when the recovery lift sets 07 down.
Salvage folding in: felt fold + glassy chime per pentatonic degree D5..F#6; the salvage melody picks the clip from the site's combo step (climbs, then weaves over the top).
Karplus-Strong felt pluck D4 + A2 body.
D3/A3/D4 hum, vibrato 4.5 Hz, wobble 0.75 Hz, 4 s seamless.
Breathy band-passed noise sweep 450->2200 Hz + falling A4->D4 hint.
Softer sighing release when the tether snaps itself: falling breath 1800->380 Hz.
Relic placed on the museum shelf: soft D3 felt tock + A4 -> D5 kalimba resolve.
Low brown-noise rumble + grit + D2/A2 drone, 6 s seamless.
Rising glassy run D5..D6 over an upward whoosh.
UiCue MenuOpen: felt piano D4 A4 D5 rolled upward.
UiCue MenuClose: felt piano A4 -> D4.
UiCue FocusMove: tiny wooden tick; the runtime rate-limits and softens rapid repeats.
UiCue SliderStep: muted kalimba tap; rate-limited and softened under repeats.
UiCue PromptShown: barely-there E5 -> A5 felt-piano grace note.
UiCue HoldFill: D5/A5 swell rising over the 0.6 s hold (UI TowerPanelSettings.HoldSeconds); stopped on release/complete.
UiCue HoldComplete: soft resolved D major felt-piano chord + music-box D6.
UiCue CardShown: music-box phrase A5 F#5 A5 -> D6 over D5.
Rising D5 -> A5.
Falling A4 -> D4.
Tilly dormant answering a ping: faint, glitchy, hopeful chirp (stutters, sags, retries).
Tilly curious 'hm?': short blip + rising question slide.
Tilly happy: bouncing pentatonic trill.
Tilly napping on her perch: slow falling coo + echo.
Tilly flying out to meet 07: rising swoop + trill landing high.
Tilly when a relic comes home: fluttering arpeggio.
Tilly spotting something: 'found it!' hop up with a bright landing.
Soft A5 bell + A6 shimmer marking what a friend spotted (relic, part, scrap).
Tilly's tiny four-rotor hum around A3, 4 s seamless; < 3.5 kHz so speed can pitch it up.
Repair stitching: D/A shimmer + D3 sewing pulse + pentatonic needle ticks, 4 s seamless.
Repaired friend boots: eye flickers, power-up glide, music-box jingle D5 F#5 A5 D6.
Friend part collected: amber vibraphone bar climbing D5 F#5 A5 B5; 'complete' on the last part resolves A5 -> D6.
Hover-Jump charge hum on D4 + spring creak; runtime steps it D E F# A B with the charge.
Leap: soft rising boing + whoosh; 'hop' for taps, 'leap' for strong charges (volume by strength).
The coils springing out on a leap: soft plucked spring.
Soft rushing air while airborne, 6 s seamless; swells with air time and speed.
Cushioned landing after a leap: air puff + muted thud + spring + dust (gentler than the thump).
The Hover-Jump coils popping in after the purchase: clunk + sproing.
Workbench purchase: spark crackles at 0/0.16/0.32 s (matching the bench's bursts) + toolbox rattle + resolved A -> D major cadence.
Bell dormant answering a ping: a dying set catching a station for a moment.
Bell's happy crackle on a new relic: static burst + two warbling blips up the scale.
Bell's station-switch crackle: detent tick + a static swish as the needle moves.
Bell's light tripod-foot taps while she walks.
Bell dozing: dial ember hum on D2/D3 + faint A3 glow + rare valve tick, 6 s seamless.
Bell waking: the hum warms up, a crackle, a sleepy E5 -> A5 hello.
Bell 'hm?': a tuning squeak settling onto a note, then the whistle sliding up like a question.
Bell happy at home: a gliding dial-whistle run up the pentatonic.
Bell sleepy: a slow whistle sagging down like a tape winding down.
Bell 'hello!': upward tuning squeak + a station-ident whistle (her jingle replaces it at home).
Bell 'got it!': a squeak locking onto a clean tone, then up a fourth.
Bell's walking effort: soft clockwork tick-tock of her legs + spring whirr + creak, 4 s seamless.
BellCued.TapeSlotted: the tape slides into her slot, clacks home and the capstan motor catches.
BellCued.NeedleSwept: lamp hum warms, the needle sweeps up the band past three faint stations.
One detent of Bell's radio dial (2D, at the dial).
Collecting a cassette: plastic clack + reels spinning up + a soft D6 counter tick.
Opening a crew log cache: tin tink + hinge creak + paper rustle.
Bell's signal pillar appearing: warm, very soft A4/D5/F#5 shimmer (played distant).
Bell's signal found: resolved A5 -> D6 chime.
Whispering Canyon bed: breathy air with a slowly moving 'vowel', 16 s seamless stereo.
The chasm trough's deeper, darker bed: low rumble + hollow 180 Hz + D2, 16 s seamless.
Solitude room tone: wide, very soft dark air + faint D2/A2, 24 s seamless stereo.
07's lamp: tiny warm hum on D3 + filament buzz, 4 s seamless.
07's servos (steering, neck): soft gear whirr + faint whine, 2 s seamless.
07's metal ticking as it cools after a drive: dry click + a tiny pentatonic ring.
A relay mast straightening: low metal groan rising, a scrape and a soft locking clunk.
A mast's lamp warming: filament catch, hum rising onto D3, A4/D5 glow.
The link answer from home's direction: old-radio A4 D5 F#5 with a breath of static.
Radio-hop leaving: static swells, band sweeps down and filters out as the screen fades.
Radio-hop landing: band sweeps up and locks onto a soft D5 carrier as the view eases in.
Cutting metal: low soft grind breathing with the beam + sparks.
Working wiring loose: dry crackle, the odd strand snap, light buzz.
Easing optics free: glassy shimmer of tiny ticks over soft air.
The beam's singing edge on D4; the runtime steps it up the pentatonic as the cut goes on.
A piece breaking loose: metal crack + clunk, wiring snap + spring, optics glassy crack + tinkle.
A site answering a ping: hull resonance on its note (depot D4, garage E4, drill F#4, kestrel A4, lander B4); '_relic' answers warmer with its octave and a D5 glow.
Soft kalimba D4 A4 D5 F#5 A5, stereo, over a quiet D/A pad.
